comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: 2026-10-22 00:30: back. A full ./dev on main (ad9138ae, load about 2) crashed the Swift test process with the same uncaught 'already on an AppKit thread' from ViewBridge's NSRemoteView. Likely cause: the find bar's new tests (1d25a6a4, Tests/MusterMacTests/FindTests.swift) make the bar's NSTextField first responder in an offscreen window, seven times - the case 7e00653f removed from the select-all test, since it starts InputMethodKit. Sent back to be asked without the input method, as 7e00653f did.

creator: Alexander Terp
description: About 3 runs in 16 of ./dev, on sources before and after 2026-09-28's rounds, the Swift test run crashes with an unexpected thread in ViewBridge. It is not tied to one change. Worth a symbolized crash log and a look at which test touches a view off the main thread.
title: The Swift suite sometimes crashes in AppKit's ViewBridge
